tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Use to compare companies against each other. Side-by-side headline fundamentals for 2–4 tickers (latest values with as-of context): market cap, close, P/E, P/S, margins, ROE, dividend yield, and 5-year revenue/EPS CAGRs. Uncovered symbols are reported honestly, not dropped silently.
